title: The Sabotaged Shift
logline: A paranoid factory manager hires a pilot to destroy malfunctioning security drones, unaware their own lead journalist is hacking them to expose labor abuses.

roles.description: Jumpy, convinced everyone is out to steal their job.
Undercover as a dock worker, deeply committed to the story.
An automated defense craft that has gone dangerously rogue.

public_situation: The {role:orbital_factory} is experiencing a rash of 'glitches' in its automated security grid, injuring several workers.
private_truth: The undercover journalist is deliberately hacking the drones to cause enough chaos to shut the factory down and expose its safety violations.

beats.public_change: A security drone goes completely rogue and begins firing on the assembly line.

missions.reason: The boss pays the pilot under the table to destroy the rogue drone before corporate inspectors arrive.
missions.private_fact: The drone's targeting systems were manually overridden.

beats.public_change: A second drone activates, this time targeting the boss's personal office.

missions.reason: The boss needs the pilot to blow open the second drone and recover its black box to prove they are being sabotaged.
missions.private_fact: The black box points directly to the journalist's hidden terminal.

beats.public_change: The entire security grid begins to power up, threatening a total massacre.

missions.reason: The pilot must destroy the main control drone before it unleashes the swarm.
missions.private_fact: The journalist hails the pilot, offering their entire life savings if the pilot lets the drone wreck the factory floor and complete the story.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the drones and stops the sabotage.
resolutions.summary: The factory is secured. The boss keeps their job, and the journalist is arrested for terrorism. The labor abuses continue unabated.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the journalist's offer.
resolutions.summary: The drones tear the factory apart. The story goes viral, exposing the horrific working conditions. The boss is fired, but hundreds of workers are now jobless.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an undercover reporter blow the lid off a brutal corporate sweatshop.

resolutions.summary: The drones eventually run out of power. The boss covers it up.

loose_threads.detail: The hacking tools the journalist used are actually sophisticated corporate espionage software, not typical investigative gear.
The boss mumbles about 'the Board' sending assassins, implying the labor abuses were ordered from the very top.

radio_hooks: Industrial accidents up 400% at {role:orbital_factory}; union demands inquiry.
Journalist {role:secret_saboteur} promises explosive exposé on local manufacturing.

voice_direction.paranoid_boss: Speaks in short, nervous bursts, constantly looking over their shoulder.
voice_direction.secret_saboteur: Intense, self-righteous, speaks in dramatic soundbites.
